title: BTC price loses 200-week trend line as 2022 repeats: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
summary: Bitcoin confirmed a weekly candle close below its 200-week moving average, copying the 2022 bear-market as traders warn of further BTC price downside next.

title: Chainalysis sues US over $95M ICE contract with TRM Labs
summary: The sealed complaint leaves Chainalysis’ specific objections and requested remedy undisclosed as briefing continues.

title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
